concerns.text: SC-001 (CC under MCAR, pass threshold ≤ 0.06, a 20% relative increase) has no task that verifies it. T103 tests only the 0.055 tipping-point threshold and T106 verifies SC-005/SC-003 flags; the coverage table maps SC-001 to T106 but T106's text never mentions the ≤0.06 MCAR criterion. Add an explicit check (e.g., in T106 or T109) that reports CC-under-MCAR error against the ≤0.06 threshold.

FR-003 mandates 500 Monte Carlo iterations per condition; T102 uses 500 but T104 (the full sweep) never states an iteration count, and plan.md targets 2000. The sweep task must name the iteration count it will use so FR-003's coverage is unambiguous — currently an implementer cannot tell which requirement T104 satisfies.

SC-003 requires the p-value distribution deviation be measured against the theoretical uniform distribution under the null with Binomial test + FDR. T103 unit-tests the Binomial test function, but no task explicitly verifies the SC-003 measurement (uniform-deviation reporting with FDR-corrected q) appears in the sweep outputs. T106's coverage-table row claims SC-003 but its text only cites SC-005 and FR-009; add the SC-003 check to T106's verification.
